## 

## Presentation

Locations for both presentations will be:
Swenson Hall of Geoscience, 820 38th St, Rock Island, IL 61201 (free parking along 38th street)
Room 210

Drone Mapping & GIS: 
Monday, December 7th, 3-5pm

Students will present their final drone mapping projects, including how they designed, planned, and conducted a safe, FAA-compliant UAS mission. They will also present their resulting map products and explain how they meet the requirements of a spatial request, with an emphasis on accuracy and image quality.


Cartography:
Friday, December 11th, 9-11am

Students will present (5-8 mins each) an original map they designed and created from scratch, using their own ideas and data to communicate a topic of their choosing. Each student will briefly introduce their map, explain its purpose and audience, and highlight design choices they made to achieve our course goal of accurate & effective spatial communication.
